post.description: Start here to find a store_key; menu, item, deals, store and wait_times need one. The source publishes the whole location list in one page, so filtering, sorting by distance and paging happen in this program.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

city.description: City name to filter on (case-insensitive, exact match on the store's city).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's next_cursor.

latitude.description:
Query point latitude; requires longitude. Results are sorted by distance.

Provider reference: minimum -90; maximum 90.

limit.description:
Stores per page (default 25).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100.

longitude.description:
Query point longitude; requires latitude.

Provider reference: minimum -180; maximum 180.

query.description: Free text matched case-insensitively against name, street address, city, store code and store key.

radius_miles.description:
Only with latitude/longitude: keep stores within this distance (default 25).

Provider reference: maximum 500.

state.description: Two-letter US state code to filter on (case-insensitive). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP; matches the store's own ZIP or a ZIP in its delivery area. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.
